propositions: HTTPS requests to /review/, /opcert/, and Gerrit's location / can receive 307/302 responses with Location headers downgrading to http:// scheme instead of https://.

The root cause is that FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS environment variable is unset for review-bot and opcert services, so uvicorn's ProxyHeadersMiddleware defaults to trusting only 127.0.0.1, but nginx connects from the docker bridge gateway (untrusted peer), causing X-Forwarded-Proto: https to be dropped and Starlette to build absolute URLs with http:// scheme.

The nginx config lacks per-location proxy_redirect rules to enforce http->https scheme rewriting on /review/, /opcert/, and Gerrit's location / block, unlike the MCP surface which received this backstop in commit 79b2.
Gerrit's guarantee currently rests on its canonicalWebUrl config value (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/), which nothing at the edge enforces.
The fix requires setting FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS: "*" on review-bot and opcert containers and adding per-location proxy_redirect http->https rules that preserve each location's existing default behavior.
